caption: The drawing depicts a green pitcher with a curved handle and an ornate, rounded body that tapers at the top and base. The pitcher is transparent in appearance, rendered in shades of green with darker green accents to indicate depth and shadows. The central part of the pitcher’s body is decorated with three reddish-brown fish, each with visible fins and scales. Surrounding the fish are white leaves attached to thin, swirling white stems that form a decorative pattern encircling the vessel. The pitcher has a wide pedestal base and a prominent pouring spout. The entire composition is set against a plain beige background, and the artist's signature, "Stewart", is visible near the base.
title: Green Pitcher
